identity_policy: Repository branding changes. Existing bundle names, namespaces, installed method folders, CLI commands, module IDs, Python distributions/imports and MCP tool IDs remain as declared by each capability.
url_rewrite_policy: Replace only the repository segment for a listed old_url. Preserve the selected @revision and #fragment; choose a newer reviewed code revision separately.
version_policy: A repository rename does not change an existing tag or commit pin and does not create a package release. A previous pin can still select older code.

github_redirects.git_and_repository_web: GitHub redirects old repository locations while the old names remain reserved. Update local remotes explicitly.
github_redirects.pages: Project Pages URLs do not receive repository rename redirects. The listed Pages paths identify old and canonical locations; use the portfolio capability guide if a project Pages location is unavailable.
github_redirects.hosted_actions: Workflow uses references to an action hosted in a renamed repository require explicit updates.

not_repository_rename_aliases.reason: Still a separate archived repository. Review its source selection explicitly; it is not a Knowledge rename alias.
